payload.name: Fluency-Based Aesthetic Pleasure/Evaluation
payload.fact: Stimuli processed more fluently are evaluated as more aesthetically pleasing and liked more; a MANOVA confirmed the perceptual fluency effect on aesthetic evaluation and pleasure.
payload.boundary: Mediated by a gut-level fluency experience; influenced by stimulus properties like symmetry, prototypicality, and contrast, and tested in an online shopping environment via visual information quality manipulation.

provenance.title: Processing Fluency and Aesthetic Pleasure: Is Beauty in the Perceiver's Processing Experience?
provenance.quote_or_locus: The more fluently perceivers can process an object, the more positive their aesthetic response

provenance.title: It felt fluent, and I liked it: Subjective feeling of fluency rather than objective fluency determines liking.
provenance.quote_or_locus: we found that objectively more fluent images were indeed judged as more fluent and were also liked more

provenance.title: The perceptual fluency effect on pleasurable online shopping experience
provenance.quote_or_locus: MANOVA results confirmed the perceptual fluency effect on aesthetic evaluation and pleasure
